csv_scope_of_work: The Borough of Penns Grove ( Borough ) hereby solicits proposals from qualified architectural firms licensed to practice in the State of New Jersey to provide architectural design, layout, and related professional services for the Borough s proposed Technology Hub and Community Center to be located at 64 East Main Street, Penns Grove, New Jersey.

title: Architectural Services for Technology Hub and Community Center
short_description: Architectural services for a technology hub and community center rehabilitation project in Penns Grove.
project_location: 64 East Main Street, Penns Grove, New Jersey, USA
project_scope: Proposed Technology Hub and Community Center at 64 East Main Street in Penns Grove, New Jersey. The notice indicates architectural design, layout, and related professional services for a building project, including rehabilitation and refurbishment. No gross floor area, structural system, span, or other technical building characteristics are stated.
services: Architectural design, layout, related professional services, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, and civil engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Building project rather than a bridge, roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Community center and technology hub could involve some design coordination, but no structural ambition or long-span features are described.
- Current procurement is primarily for architectural services, which can be strategically relevant, but this is not a major cultural, university, or landmark building.
- No sustainability, innovation, special materials, or complex structural requirements are mentioned.
- Rehabilitation/refurbishment may create some engineering scope, but the notice provides no evidence of demanding structural work.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the notice. Available cost-related inputs are limited to the project type (technology hub and community center), location (Penns Grove, New Jersey), and that rehabilitation/refurbishment is included. Without building size, program area, or scope definition, no realistic estimate can be made from the provided text alone.
fee_explanation: No design fee or budget is stated in the notice. Since construction cost, floor area, and service scope by phase are not defined, a realistic fee estimate is not possible from the provided information.
references_qualifications: Qualified architectural firms licensed to practice in the State of New Jersey.
